other_conditions: Applicant must be the widow of the deceased ex‑serviceman, or any other family member if the widow has died
The deceased ex‑serviceman or deceased widow must have been registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry

Eligible beneficiaries include ex‑servicemen and living spouses/widows who are re‑employed as regular or deemed‑regular in government, public sector undertakings, private organisations or as self‑employed in IT
benefits_summary: A cash assistance of ₹12,000 is paid to the widow of a deceased ex‑serviceman, and ₹10,000 is paid to a family member if the widow of the ex‑serviceman dies.
